metadata.name: stock_vault
metadata.description: SAFU Credit: USDC loans against tokenized stocks, with wrongful-liquidation guards

instructions.name: absorb_bad_debt_cover
docs: Credits USDC sitting in the market's vault beyond what the market has accounted for, against
bad debt. Permissionless and authority-free by construction.
The backstop reimburses bad debt by simply transferring USDC into this market's USDC vault.
Cash is tracked internally precisely so a raw transfer cannot move the share price, which
means that reimbursement would otherwise sit unaccounted forever. This instruction is the one
place unaccounted surplus may be recognised, and it is bounded by `bad_debt` — so a stranger
donating tokens can repair a write-off but can never inflate the pool beyond it. Anything
above the outstanding bad debt stays unaccounted, exactly as before.

instructions.name: acknowledge_multiplier
docs: Clears a hold raised by `unobserved_multiplier_change`. The feed authority or the admin
attests that the price feed and the token's multiplier are back in step, and the market
resumes against the new value.
This is an operational gate on an unannounced corporate action, not a claims decision: it
cannot move anyone's money, cannot raise or lower a payout, and is recorded on-chain by the
event below.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: Read for the live multiplier schedule.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: Read for the live multiplier schedule and issuer controls.

instructions.name: deposit_collateral
docs: Adding collateral only reduces risk, so it is allowed while paused.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody watching the deploy can call it
first and take admin. Initialize before any `--final`: a program with no upgrade authority can
never be initialized.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program. Proves `program_data` belongs to it, not to a program the caller deployed.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Permissionless liquidation of a position past its threshold.
The liquidator repays USDC on the borrower's behalf and receives collateral at a bonus that
grows with how far the position has drifted, bounded by solvency, the close factor, and a
chunk cap sized from measured liquidity. Everything used to price the seizure is snapshotted
into a `LiquidationRecord`: the wrongful-liquidation verdict is decided off-chain against
exactly these inputs, and must never be re-derived from a later feed state.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the record's rent. Separate from `liquidator` so the backstop pool, whose key is a program-owned
PDA that cannot fund an account, can liquidate with a crank wallet paying the rent (eng review A1).

accounts.name: liquidator
docs: Authorizes the USDC in and receives the collateral out.

accounts.name: record
docs: Seeded by the market's own counter, so each liquidation gets its own immutable record and a
replayed transaction cannot overwrite an earlier one.

instructions.name: mark_liquidatable
docs: Permissionless. Records that a position can be liquidated right now (every liquidation guard passes and
it is past its line), or clears the record if it cannot. The pool may liquidate at any time; outside
liquidators only once the position has been marked for the grace period and the mark is still fresh.
A mark older than twice the grace period restarts the clock, so a position that recovered and fell
again gets the pool's full head start.

instructions.name: pay_backer_interest
docs: Pays backers their accrued interest share to the registered pool (eng review addendum,
founder-locked 15%). Permissionless, and -- like `absorb_bad_debt_cover` -- a plain token
transfer only: the market never calls the backstop program. Capped at `market.cash`: under
high utilization the payment waits until enough cash exists rather than borrowing against
principal, and nothing is lost while it waits.

accounts.name: pool_usdc_vault
docs: The registered pool's own USDC vault -- constrained to `config.pool_liquidator` so interest
can only ever be paid to the pool the vault admin actually registered, never to an arbitrary
caller-supplied account.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Anyone may repay a position. Allowed while paused (it only reduces risk).

instructions.name: set_admin
docs: Admin rotation (U5), matching the backstop. Refuses the default key, which would leave the
vault with no reachable admin.

instructions.name: set_fallback_grace
docs: How long a position must be liquidatable before outside liquidators may act. Bounded 1 min (5 min on
mainnet, eng review A5) to 1 day.

instructions.name: set_feed_authority
docs: Key rotation (U5).

instructions.name: set_payout_address
docs: Where this position's wrongful-liquidation payback goes. Owner only. Refuses the default key and
the vault's own admin and feed keys (the backstop refuses its oracle and co-signer at payout). A
liquidation record freezes the address, so a later change, or a stolen key, cannot redirect a
payback already owed.

instructions.name: set_pool_liquidator
docs: Registers the backstop pool's liquidator key (its config PDA). Default unregisters it, which leaves the
grace rule applying to every liquidator. Never the vault admin or the feed authority.

instructions.name: sync_issuer_state
docs: Permissionless. Re-derives the issuer-controlled facts the market must respect and records
them, so a halt can be raised (or lifted) without waiting for someone to attempt a risk
action. It reflects observable on-chain state only, which is why it needs no authority.
A burn by the mint's permanent delegate leaves `reconciliation_short` true until
`write_down_collateral` attributes the missing tokens; the halt is correct until then — the
market genuinely cannot honour the collateral it has recorded.

instructions.name: update_market_params
docs: U2/U3: interest accrues at the old rate up to now; open loans keep their coverage snapshot.

instructions.name: write_down_collateral
docs: Admin-only recovery from an issuer seizure (spec 14). The mint's permanent delegate can burn tokens out of
the shared collateral vault; the chain then shows tokens missing but not whose, and the market halts
permanently (`reconciliation_short`). This attributes the missing amount to the position it was taken from.
Bounded so it can only ever restore the books, never take anything real: allowed only while the vault is
actually short, never more than the shortfall, never more than the position holds. The position is marked
`issuer_seized` for good: its later liquidations can't back a payback claim, and debt it leaves unpaid is
issuer loss that the backstop never reimburses. Once every missing token is attributed, the next
`sync_issuer_state` lifts the halt (unless the mint itself is still paused or the vault frozen).

types.name: Liquidated
docs: Everything the off-chain verdict engine needs to start from, without reading the record account.

types.name: LiquidationRecord
docs: Immutable snapshot of one liquidation.
The verdict engine decides wrongfulness off-chain, so it must be able to re-derive the decision
from what the contract actually used — not from whatever the feed says later. Every input that
fed the seizure is recorded here, including `issuer_halt` at the time, because a liquidation
taken while the issuer had intervened is excluded from cover (spec 14a).

fields.name: seized_raw
docs: Raw collateral handed to the liquidator.

fields.name: debt_repaid
docs: USDC the liquidator repaid on the borrower's behalf.

fields.name: multiplier_fp
docs: Effective multiplier used for the valuation, in `MULT_SCALE` fixed point.

fields.name: price_fp
docs: TWAP the seizure was priced at, 8 decimals.

fields.name: ltv_bps
docs: Position LTV at the moment of seizure.

fields.name: coverage_bps
docs: Coverage in force for this borrower when the loan was opened (U3).

fields.name: borrow_age_ts
docs: The loan's debt-weighted borrow time at the moment of liquidation (for the 60-day gate).

fields.name: payout
docs: Payback address at the moment of liquidation. Frozen here; later changes cannot redirect it.

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Debt written off because the collateral ran out, 0 in the normal case.

types.name: LiquidationTerms
docs: The terms that decide when, and how hard, an existing loan is liquidated. Changes that tighten them
ramp in over `LIQUIDATION_TERMS_RAMP_SECS`, so no borrower is liquidated overnight by a number change.

types.name: LiquidationTermsTightening
docs: A parameter change tightened the liquidation terms. Existing loans reach `to` gradually, completing
at `completes` (U3). Announced on-chain so borrowers can add collateral or repay in time.

fields.name: cash
docs: USDC held, tracked internally. Never inferred from the vault balance (donation attacks).

fields.name: borrow_index
docs: Debt index, 1.0 == safu_core::lending::INDEX_SCALE.

fields.name: total_collateral_raw
docs: Sum of all positions' raw collateral, for reconciliation against the vault (review D4).

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Bad debt still uncovered. Falls when the backstop reimburses it.

fields.name: bad_debt_cumulative
docs: Every write-off this market has ever taken, monotonic. The backstop compares its own running
total against this to work out what it still owes, which makes reimbursement idempotent with
no epoch counter to keep in step.

fields.name: observed_multiplier_fp
docs: Effective multiplier this market last acted on, in `MULT_SCALE` fixed point. The baseline the
unannounced-change guard compares the live value against. Seeded by `create_market`; 0 means
"not yet observed", which the guard treats as no change rather than as a change from zero.

fields.name: ramp_from
docs: Where the current liquidation-terms ramp started from, and when (U3). The target is `params`.
Taken from the old 40 reserved bytes (20 + 8), so the account size is unchanged (U4).

fields.name: backer_interest_owed
docs: Interest credited to backers but not yet paid out (eng review addendum). Excluded from
`total_assets`, so lenders' share price reflects only their 85% (2c pattern, in reverse).

fields.name: backer_interest_cumulative
docs: Monotonic total ever credited, mirrored by `InterestAbsorbed.total_absorbed` on the backstop
side so repeat `absorb_interest` calls settle only the remainder.

fields.name: backer_interest_paid_cumulative
docs: Monotonic total ever transferred to the pool via `pay_backer_interest`.

fields.name: issuer_loss_cumulative
docs: Debt written off on positions whose collateral the issuer seized (`write_down_collateral`). Kept apart
from `bad_debt_cumulative` on purpose: the backstop reimburses only that counter, and issuer actions are
never covered (spec 14a) -- lenders carry this loss, as they carry it on every market holding this token.
Taken from the old 12 reserved bytes, so the account size is unchanged (U4).

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Admin-settable within hard bounds (U2). Values and the evidence behind each:
`outputs/2026-09-14_stocklana-market-config-research.md` §2b (research-ops).

fields.name: ltv_bps
docs: Borrowing limit. AAPLx: 4_000 (matched to the market leader).

fields.name: liq_threshold_bps
docs: Liquidation line. AAPLx: 5_000.

fields.name: min_liq_bonus_bps
docs: Dynamic liquidation bonus: max(min, LTV − threshold), capped at max and at 100% − LTV. 100 / 500.

fields.name: insolvency_ltv_bps
docs: Above this LTV the whole debt may be liquidated at once. 9_500.

fields.name: close_factor_bps
docs: Share of debt repayable per liquidation below the insolvency line. 2_500.

fields.name: max_liquidation_debt
docs: USDC base units per liquidation, sized from measured collateral liquidity ($100K).

fields.name: deviation_cap_bps
docs: Single-update spike cap vs TWAP. 500 (US LULD Tier 1 band).

fields.name: activation_pause_secs
docs: Issuer-recommended pause around every multiplier activation. 900 s.

fields.name: split_cap_bps
docs: A multiplier change above this is a split / reverse split. 500.

fields.name: split_max_hold_secs
docs: Longest a split can hold risk actions while waiting for a market-open price. 86_400 s.

fields.name: borrow_max_price_age_secs
docs: Borrow / withdraw need a price at most this old while the market is open. 3_600 s.

fields.name: liquidation_max_price_age_open_secs
docs: Liquidation price age limit while open (feed's own 0.5% / 24h guarantee + 1h). 90_000 s.

fields.name: max_price_age_closed_secs
docs: Any action while the underlying market is closed (longest US closure ≈ 89.5h). 345_600 s.

fields.name: borrow_cap
docs: Total USDC that may be lent (backstop sizing rule, 10:1). Base units.

fields.name: collateral_cap_raw
docs: Total raw collateral accepted.

fields.name: backer_interest_share_bps
docs: Share of accrued borrower interest credited to backers, bounded <= 5_000 (founder-locked at
1_500 = 15%; eng review addendum 2026-09-14). A change applies to interest accrued after it.

fields.name: coverage_bps
docs: Coverage in force when this loan was opened (U3: later changes never shrink an open loan's cover).

fields.name: borrow_age_ts
docs: Debt-weighted borrow time (unix seconds), 0 while there is no debt. Each borrow pulls it toward
now in proportion to its size; full repayment resets it. The backstop's 60-day gate reads it, so
a tiny early loan topped up after a price breaks still counts as young.

fields.name: payout
docs: Where a wrongful-liquidation payback goes. Defaults to the owner, who may change it. A liquidation
record freezes it, so nobody can redirect a payback after the fact.

fields.name: liquidatable_first_seen
docs: When this position was first seen liquidatable by `mark_liquidatable`, and most recently. 0 = not
marked. Outside liquidators wait on these; the pool does not.

fields.name: issuer_seized
docs: Set by `write_down_collateral` once any of this position's collateral is attributed to an issuer seizure.
Permanent. Every later liquidation of this position records `issuer_halt = true`, so the backstop refuses
a payback claim on it, and any debt it leaves behind is issuer loss, never reimbursable bad debt.

fields.name: seized_raw_total
docs: Raw collateral ever written down on this position.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Taken from the old 32 reserved bytes (8 + 8 + 1 + 8).

fields.name: prices
docs: Ring buffer, USD per whole share with 8 decimals.

fields.name: head
docs: Next write position.

fields.name: market_open
docs: Whether the underlying equity market was open at the last accepted update.

fields.name: flagged
docs: Set when an update broke the spike cap. Blocks borrowing and liquidation until cleared.

fields.name: flagged_price
docs: The rejected price, so a second consecutive update confirming it can be accepted.

fields.name: feed_authority
docs: Pushes prices through the mock adapter on devnet. Separate key from the verdict oracle.

fields.name: pool_liquidator
docs: The backstop pool's liquidator key (its config PDA). It may liquidate at once; anyone else only after
the grace period. Default = no pool registered, so the grace rule applies to every liquidator.

fields.name: fallback_grace_secs
docs: How long a position must have been liquidatable before an outside liquidator may act. 900 s.

fields.name: cluster_tag
docs: Which cluster this deployment is on (0 localnet, 1 devnet, 2 mainnet), set once at initialize with no
setter. Selects the time floors (eng review A5): mainnet may never shorten the grace below 5 min.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Taken from the old 64 reserved bytes (32 + 8 + 1), so the account size is unchanged (U4).
